numerical_characteristics.magnitude: Flat indices reach 8193 in the reproducer (input shape (8194,)), and the regression test uses np.arange(10_000) with unravel shape (100, 100).
category_specific_evidence: Violated property: unravel_index and ravel_multi_index should be inverses, so ravel_multi_index(unravel_index(i, shape), shape) should equal i for every flat index i.
Concrete violation: flat index 8193 is expected to map to (8, 193) but the 2-D path returns (8, 192).
Round-trip result: the 2-D round-tripped value at position 8193 is 8192 instead of 8193, giving 1 mismatch out of 8194 elements (0.0122%).
The 1-D input of shape (8194,) returns the correct coordinate 8 193 at that position, so the discrepancy appears only for the 2-D input of shape (8194, 1) with strides (8, 8).
Assertion output: ACTUAL ends in 191, 192, 192 while DESIRED ends in 191, 192, 193.

The added regression test (test_unravel_index_buffer_boundary) builds indices = np.arange(10_000, dtype=np.intp)[:, None], calls unravel_index with shape (100, 100), and asserts ravel_multi_index recovers indices.
The C fix in nditer_constr.c targets buffered iterator stride handling after RemoveMultiIndex, where a size-one inner axis with zero stride may be coalesced.
reproduction_risks: The mismatch depends on the 2-D (N, 1) shape of the input, so a 1-D-only reproduction will not show it
